source.full_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: repeatable base-colour/albedo surface texture for Captain LivÃ©'s pirate cabin in S0ulRebel/cruises. Match the already-inspected existing cabin, cartoon pirate Captain LivÃ©, painted wooden props, desk lantern and globe: rich but restrained warm colours, broad graphic brush shapes, simplified hand-painted cartoon adventure-game material. Not photorealism, not photographic scans. Make one flat, edge-to-edge SQUARE texture, target 2048x2048. Orthographic surface only, no room, no object, no frame, no text or labels. Neutral evenly lit base colour, no baked directional light, no lantern glow, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion vignette, no glossy highlights or bevel highlights, no relief-rendered deep grooves. This is texture colour, not a beauty render. SEAMLESS toroidal tiling in BOTH axes: motifs/grain/colours leaving the left edge continue at the right edge in exactly the same position and slope; top edge continues at bottom in the same way. No border, no margin, no fade at edges; edges are a continuation of the same material. Avoid distinct large knots or marks that draw attention to a repeat. Dense enough to read as material, simplified enough for fixed-camera 1080p gameplay. Material: WALL PLANKS. Dark reddish walnut/chestnut boards matching the cabin wall and approved bookcase/crate. Eight horizontal long planks from left to right in exactly equal-height bands, narrow dark painted seams. This is a quieter, darker companion to the honey chestnut floorboards already made. Warm chocolate base, subdued burnt sienna flat grain colour, sparing tiny knots, low contrast. Board grain must flow horizontally. No bevels, no nail heads, no ornate panels, no furniture or plank edge silhouettes. No shiny orange edge highlights. The top and bottom boundaries land on equivalent plank seams; left and right colours, grain and seam positions must match to repeat without a visible tile boundary. Broad elegant cartoon brushstrokes, not millions of fibrous scratches.

tiling.uv_rule: For a surface S_u by S_v metres, use UV extent (S_u / tile_span_u, S_v / tile_span_v). Sample with repeat enabled and mipmaps. Preserve density when the surface dimensions change; do not stretch a single tile to fit the room. Rotate UVs to align wood grain with the long direction of real pieces.

validation.repeat_preview: 2x2 simple repeats visually inspected; no image edge correction performed
validation.limits: Generated periodic colour is approximate, not pixel-identical at opposite edges. Small colour/grain transitions remain; live camera, mipmaps and material repeat must be inspected before calling the scene seam-free. 2048px was requested; native delivered size is1254px and is retained.

lighting.intent: Neutral base colour with painted grain variation; no directional scene light
lighting.remaining: Inspect under existing toon scene lights; use matte roughness about0.9 for wood,1.0 for carpet, zero metallic. These are art suggestions, not measured PBR maps.

scene_adoption.lighting: Runtime painted fake-light shader; no texture lighting bake.
scene_adoption.seam_acceptance: Reviewed at authored camera; approximate motifs/edges retained, no exact seamless claim.
